title: Active Directory Authentication
description: Enables user authentication against Active Directory.

settings_def.name: domain_name
settings_def.label: Domain Name
settings_def.description: The FQDN name for users in this directory. For example, a user alice@acme.com would have a domain of acme.com. This option is not required, but if it is not supplied, usernames in principal name form (e.g., alice@acme.com) are not supported.

settings_def.name: short_domain_name
settings_def.label: Short Domain Name
settings_def.description: The "short" domain name for users in this directory like "ACME". Note that there is a 1:1 mapping between this short name and the domain name above. This option should be used to specify the NetBIOS domain name for Windows networks. This option is not required but if it is not supplied, usernames in backslash form (e.g., ACME\alice) are not supported.

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

settings_def.name: sync_enabled
settings_def.label: Enable Auto Sync
settings_def.checkbox_label: Routinely sync user information from this usersource to Deskpro

settings_def.name: disable_cert_validation
settings_def.label: Disable certificate validation
settings_def.description: Allows to use self-sigend SSL certificate.

settings_def.name: disable_ldap_paging
settings_def.label: Disable LDAP Paging
settings_def.description: By default, our sync system uses LDAP Paging to retrieve results. Paging is recommended for Active Directory sync. Check this box if you want to disable paging.

settings_def.name: ldap_per_page
settings_def.label: LDAP Size Limit
settings_def.description: By default, Active Directory has a size limit of 1000. If your server has a smaller limit, please enter it here.

settings_def.name: raw_info_filter
settings_def.label: Filter
settings_def.description: You can filter based on info provided by the usersource. Learn about this feature
